about.checkAdmin: Only an administrator can check for updates.
about.creditsBody: Router-LLM is a Go rewrite of 9Router by decolua and its extended fork by thunderkex. Both are MIT-licensed behavior references: their behavior was studied, and no source was copied.
about.intro: Router-LLM (rllmx) is an LLM gateway in Go: one endpoint speaks the OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Responses and Ollama client APIs and routes to many upstream providers.
about.licenseBody: Router-LLM is released under the MIT License. The repository's LICENSE file holds the full text.
about.restarting: Installed. The router is restarting; reload in a moment.
about.title: About
about.upToDate: This build is the newest release.
about.updateBody: This downloads the release, replaces this binary and restarts the router. A misconfigured host stays down until it is started again.
about.updateHow: Or run `rllmx artisan upgrade` on the host: it downloads this platform's release, verifies its checksum, replaces the binary and restarts it.

saver.cavemanHint: Terse-style system prompt: about 65% fewer output tokens, up to 87%.
saver.customPromptHint: Text appended to every request, whatever the provider or model.
saver.headroomHint: Compression is done by a Headroom server on your network; nothing is bundled with the router.
saver.headroomSetup: Start the sidecar yourself; the dashboard does not manage processes.
saver.hint: Each saver rewrites or appends to a request before it leaves the router. A failure in any of them leaves the request untouched.
saver.levelDesc.full: The balance the reference ships as the default.
saver.levelDesc.lite: Lightest touch: the fewest words change.
saver.levelDesc.ultra: Strongest: the answer is compressed the most, at some cost in nuance.
saver.ponytailHint: Biases the model toward minimal code: YAGNI, reuse the standard library, deletion over addition.
saver.promptSaveHint: Saved when the field loses focus.
saver.rtkHint: A tool result is compacted in place before translation. A failing result and an error status are left alone.
saver.title: Token Saver
saver.watermarkHint: Asks the model not to emit invisible characters, provenance marks or AI transition clichés, in smart or always mode.
saver.watermarkStripHint: Removes zero-width spaces and joiners, the BOM, soft hyphens and bidi controls from every answer, streaming included, whatever the model sent.
settings.comboStickyHint: Used with combo round robin only; 1 to 1000.
settings.loginOffWarning: Anyone who can reach this port can open the dashboard. Turn it on unless a trusted private network covers the whole route.
settings.oidcNeedsSecret: Issuer URL, client ID and client secret are required to turn OIDC on.
settings.oidcSecretKeep: Leave blank to keep the stored secret
settings.passwordDefault: The default password is in use.
settings.requireLoginHint: When on, the dashboard asks for a password or a single sign-on. When off, a local caller still needs a session for keys and provider logins.
settings.ssoHint: The mode decides what the sign-in page offers. A person the provider authenticates is an admin when their address is on AUTH_SSO_ADMIN, and a standard user otherwise.
settings.stickyHint: Used with round robin only; 1 to 100.
settings.title: Settings
skills.allOff: The master switch is off, so the server runs no skill at all.
skills.catalogHint: Scored against each request and injected when the match clears the threshold. The rows below are the imported skills; the switch above runs the router.
skills.deleteBody: This removes the folder and its files. Delete
skills.groupOff: This card is off. Its skills keep their own switches; turning it back on restores them.
skills.hint: A skill is data the router reads: a system prompt, a pre-route rule, or a pre-request rewrite. Nothing here runs a process.
skills.planHint: On a hard request, the router plans first and then asks a code combo to answer. The mode below decides whether the decision is automatic or the two combos are fixed.
skills.planShow: Show the plan in the answer
skills.planSmart: Classify first, so an easy request skips the plan
skills.planThresholdHint: 1 to 3 plans aggressively, 4 to 7 balances, 8 to 10 plans only what is clearly hard.
skills.reaBody: REA Allow removes the security-policy paragraphs a client puts in its system prompt and replaces them with responsible reverse-engineering guidance. Only turn it on for work on software you own or are authorised to examine.
skills.reaHint: Replaces the client's security-policy paragraphs. Enable only for lawful work on software you own or are authorised to examine.
skills.studioNoRules: No rule yet. A skill with no rule does nothing.
skills.syncForce: Replace a folder with the same id
skills.syncHint: Fetches the official ECC catalog over https and imports the skills it holds. A git clone is the only process the router starts.
skills.synced: The catalog was fetched and applied.
